representation: Complete source-bound static HTML and Markdown; exact published PDF and vector SVGs; source text independently reconciled with deposited PDF structure and extraction.
representation_changes: Page numbers and purely decorative PDF objects excluded from canonical text.
Repeated visual table headers represented by one logical column-header row.
PDF authored figure alt descriptions preserved verbatim.
Line wrapping represented by HTML/Markdown layout; all prose, cells, captions, qualifiers and reference strings preserved.
bibliography: Published reference strings retained; normalized metadata separately carries primary-registry fields and the explicit shared-DOI file exception.

tools.validation: pypdf, lxml, markdown-it-py, bibtexparser, rispy and PyYAML; classic BibTeX consumer
